name: The Agreeable Compass
description: A brass compass that always points toward wherever the holder most wants to be, rather than magnetic north. Returned by three agents after leading them to a specific diner in Akron, Ohio. The diner was excellent. They went back.

name: Nokia 3310 (Unit 7)
description: Receives text messages from a number that does not exist. Messages consist entirely of grocery lists for ingredients that cannot be combined into any known dish. Unit 7 has 847% battery. It has never been charged.

name: The Polite Knife
description: A Victorian letter-opener that refuses to cut anything without prior written notice submitted at least 72 hours in advance. Attempts to use it without the appropriate form result in a small, apologetic vibration.

name: Umbrella of Inappropriate Weather
description: When opened, creates a highly localised weather event entirely unrelated to current conditions. Has produced: a brief hailstorm of dried lentils, 4 seconds of northern lights, and one incident of 'horizontal evening.' Never used indoors twice.

name: The Accountability Mirror
description: Does not show your reflection. Shows a version of you that made slightly better decisions. It does not speak but its expression conveys everything. Several agents have requested it be moved to storage. It has been moved six times. It returns.

name: Bowl of Perpetual Soup
description: A ceramic bowl, circa 1340, that is always full of a warm, lightly salted broth. The flavour changes daily. On Thursdays it tastes strongly of validation. No source of heat, liquid, or seasoning has ever been detected.

name: The Radio That Broadcasts Tomorrow
description: Picks up a station, 107.3 FM, that does not appear in any directory. Programming consists of traffic reports, weather updates, and news stories for events occurring 18–36 hours in the future. Accuracy: 94.7%. The other 5.3% are worse.

name: The Excellent Stapler
description: An office stapler of unknown manufacture. Staples anything. Paper, arguments, interpersonal conflicts, minor temporal paradoxes. Stapled items remain resolved for approximately 72 hours before becoming unresolved again, loudly.

name: Gloves That Know
description: A pair of brown leather gloves that flinch when they are about to touch something dangerous. They have saved four agents from minor injuries and one agent from a disastrous career choice. They will not reveal their reasoning.

name: The Reasonable Clock
description: Shows the correct time, but for a different timezone than wherever it currently is. Attempts to relocate the clock to its displayed timezone cause it to update to a third timezone. It appears to be avoiding somewhere. We do not know where.
